WITH demand AS (
    SELECT ol.product_id, COUNT(*) AS line_count, SUM(ol.qty) AS ordered_qty,
           MIN(ol.qty) AS smallest_line, GROUP_CONCAT(ol.id || '=' || ol.qty) AS order_lines
    FROM main.orderlines AS ol
    WHERE ol.order_id = 423
    GROUP BY ol.product_id
), stock AS (
    SELECT i.product_id, SUM(i.qty) AS inventory_qty, MIN(i.qty) AS smallest_lot,
           MIN(p.purchased) AS first_purchase, MAX(p.purchased) AS last_purchase,
           SUM(CASE WHEN p.id IS NULL OR p.product_id <> i.product_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_issues
    FROM main.inventory AS i
    JOIN main.locations AS l ON l.id = i.location_id
    LEFT JOIN main.purchases AS p ON p.id = i.purchase_id
    WHERE l.warehouse = 1
    GROUP BY i.product_id
)
SELECT d.*, s.inventory_qty, s.smallest_lot, s.first_purchase, s.last_purchase, s.purchase_issues
FROM demand AS d
LEFT JOIN stock AS s ON s.product_id = d.product_id
ORDER BY d.product_id

arguments.sql:
WITH line_demand AS (
    SELECT ol.id AS order_line_id,
           ol.product_id,
           ol.qty,
           SUM(ol.qty) OVER (
               PARTITION BY ol.product_id
               ORDER BY ol.id
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS demand_end
    FROM main.orderlines AS ol
    WHERE ol.order_id = 423
),
warehouse_stock AS (
    SELECT i.product_id,
           l.aisle,
           l.position,
           i.qty,
           SUM(i.qty) OVER (
               PARTITION BY i.product_id
               ORDER BY p.purchased, i.qty, i.id
               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
           ) AS stock_end
    FROM main.inventory AS i
    JOIN main.locations AS l ON l.id = i.location_id
    JOIN main.purchases AS p ON p.id = i.purchase_id
    WHERE l.warehouse = 1
      AND i.qty > 0
      AND i.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM line_demand)
)
SELECT d.order_line_id,
       d.product_id,
       s.aisle,
       s.position,
       SUM(
           MIN(d.demand_end, s.stock_end)
           - MAX(d.demand_end - d.qty, s.stock_end - s.qty)
       ) AS qty_to_pick
FROM line_demand AS d
JOIN warehouse_stock AS s
  ON s.product_id = d.product_id
 AND s.stock_end > d.demand_end - d.qty
 AND d.demand_end > s.stock_end - s.qty
WHERE d.qty > 0
GROUP BY d.order_line_id, d.product_id, s.aisle, s.position
ORDER BY d.order_line_id, MIN(s.stock_end - s.qty), s.aisle, s.position
